fusions.name: Lunge From Stillness
fusions.desc: A sudden lunge that deals 28 poison damage, ignores the target's resistances and leaves it [Poisoned] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Flicked Point
fusions.desc: A tongue-quick flick that deals 4 damage and leaves the target 4% easier to wound for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Basking
fusions.desc: Restores 3 health a second to you for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Cold Blood, Long Wait
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 5. At 5 they all spend at once: you heal for 4% of your maximum health per stack (20% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 8 seconds.
